  • Assessment of Sports Achievements and Educational Qualification
  • Document Verification
  • Medical Examination

Minimum qualifying marks: Level-5/4 – 70, Level-3/2 – 65, Level-1 – 60. Merit will decide appointment. In case of a tie, the younger candidate will get preference.
